cards.ex: I've been having a creative block lately; I can't seem to come up with any new ideas.
cards.exUz: Oxirgi paytlarda ijodiy tòsiq bo'lyapti; yangi g'oyalar o'ylab topolmayapman.
cards.uzDef: Ijod qilish qobiliyatining vaqtincha yo'qolishi yoki qiyinlashuvi.

cards.ex: To solve this problem, we need to think outside the box.
cards.exUz: Bu muammoni yechish uchun qolipdan tashqari fikrlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: An'anaviy fikrlash usullaridan farqli, yangicha yondashuv.

cards.ex: That new design was a stroke of genius.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi dizayn daho zarbasi edi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmaganda paydo bo'lgan, juda yaxshi g'oya yoki fikr.

cards.ex: The author really paints a picture of life in the countryside.
cards.exUz: Muallif qishloq hayotini juda yaxshi tasvirlab beradi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani batafsil va jonli tasvirlab berish.

cards.ex: I was just walking in the park when inspiration struck.
cards.exUz: Parkda sayr qilib yurgan edim, birdan ilhom keldi.
cards.uzDef: Ilhomning birdaniga paydo bo'lishi, g'oyalar kelishi.

cards.ex: The movie takes some artistic license with the historical facts.
cards.exUz: Film tarixiy faktlar bilan biroz badiiy erkinlikka yo'l qo'yadi.
cards.uzDef: San'atkorning haqiqatdan chekinish huquqi, o'z talqinida.

cards.ex: You can cultivate creativity by trying new things and taking risks.
cards.exUz: Yangi narsalarni sinab ko'rish va tavakkal qilish orqali ijodni rivojlantirish mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ijodiy qobiliyatlarni o'stirish va rivojlantirish.

cards.ex: The artist is known for pushing the boundaries of modern art.
cards.exUz: Rassom zamonaviy san'atning chegaralarini kengaytirishi bilan tanilgan.
cards.uzDef: An'anaviy chegaralardan o'tib, yangi imkoniyatlarni izlash.

cards.ex: This painting looks like a masterpiece in the making.
cards.exUz: Bu rasm shoh asar yaratilayotganga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Yaratilayotgan juda yaxshi asar.

cards.ex: It takes time to find your voice as a writer.
cards.exUz: Yozuvchi sifatida o'z ovozingni topish uchun vaqt kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'ziga xos uslubni yoki fikrlash tarzini topish.

cards.ex: We're on the same wavelength when it comes to designing the website.
cards.exUz: Veb-saytni loyihalashda biz bir to'lqindamiz.
cards.uzDef: Fikrlarining mos kelishi, bir xil fikrlash.

cards.ex: Let's brainstorm some ideas for our next project.
cards.exUz: Keyingi loyihamiz uchun g'oyalar to'plamini tuzaylik.
cards.uzDef: G'oyalarni birgalikda ishlab chiqish, muhokama qilish.

cards.ex: The company has a think tank dedicated to innovation.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyada innovatsiyaga bag'ishlangan fikrlar markazi mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Turli xil fikrlovchi odamlarning guruhi.

cards.ex: The project failed, so it's back to the drawing board.
cards.exUz: Loyiha muvaffaqiyatsiz tugadi, shuning uchun boshidan boshlash kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi boshlash, avvalgi reja ish bermaganda.

cards.ex: Starting a new business is like having a blank canvas.
cards.exUz: Yangi biznes boshlash bo'sh tuvalga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi boshlash imkoniyati, hech narsa yo'q joydan boshlash.

cards.ex: He believes in art for art's sake, not for commercial gain.
cards.exUz: U san'at san'at uchun, tijorat foydasi uchun emas, deb hisoblaydi.
cards.uzDef: San'atning faqat estetik qiymati uchun yaratilishi.

cards.ex: Art is a great way to express yourself.
cards.exUz: San'at - o'zini ifoda etishning ajoyib usuli.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrlarini, his-tuyg'ularini san'at orqali ifodalash.

cards.ex: The house is still a work in progress, but it's coming along nicely.
cards.exUz: Uy hali ish jarayonida, lekin yaxshi ketmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Hali tugallanmagan, ustida ish olib borilayotgan asar.

cards.ex: Traveling to new places can spark creativity.
cards.exUz: Yangi joylarga sayohat qilish ijodni uyg'otishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ijodiy jarayonni boshlash, yangi g'oyalarni keltirib chiqarish.

cards.ex: She has an outside-the-box approach to problem-solving.
cards.exUz: U muammolarni hal qilishda qolipdan tashqari yondashuvga ega.
cards.uzDef: An'anaviy fikrlash doirasidan tashqarida.

cards.ex: It takes years to hone your craft as a musician.
cards.exUz: Musiqachi sifatida mahoratni oshirish uchun yillar kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: O'z mahoratini takomillashtirish, ustalik darajasiga yetkazish.

cards.ex: Restoring the old car was a labor of love.
cards.exUz: Eski mashinani tiklash sevgi mehnat edi.
cards.uzDef: Sevgi va qiziqish bilan qilingan ish.

cards.ex: The music really got my creative juices flowing.
cards.exUz: Musiqa meni haqiqatan ham ilhomlantirdi.
cards.uzDef: Ijodiy fikrlash jarayonining boshlanishi, ilhomlanish.

cards.ex: Dare to create something that challenges the norm.
cards.exUz: Me'yorni buzadigan narsalarni yaratishga jur'at eting.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va o'ziga xos narsalarni yaratishga jur'at qilish.

cards.ex: The artist is suddenly in the spotlight after winning the award.
cards.exUz: Rassom mukofotni yutganidan so'ng birdaniga diqqat markazida bo'lib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'pchilikning diqqat markazida bo'lish.

cards.ex: She's a rising star in the art world.
cards.exUz: U san'at olamida yuksalayotgan yulduz.
cards.uzDef: Tez orada mashhur bo'ladigan iste'dodli inson.

cards.ex: He decorated the room with artistic flair.
cards.exUz: U xonani badiiy did bilan bezatdi.
cards.uzDef: San'atga xos bo'lgan uslub, noziklik.

cards.ex: The painting captures the essence of the landscape.
cards.exUz: Rasm landshaftning mohiyatini aks ettiradi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning asosiy, eng muhim jihatini aks ettirish.

cards.ex: The photographer has an eye for detail.
cards.exUz: Fotograf mayda detallarga e'tiborli.
cards.uzDef: Mayda detallarga e'tiborli bo'lish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: Painting is a creative outlet for her.
cards.exUz: Rasm chizish uning uchun ijodiy chiqish yo'li.
cards.uzDef: Ijodiy energiyani chiqarish uchun vosita.
